prompt:
Teams want to see at a glance whether a column holds more work in progress than agreed. Please add a check that runs as `python -m kanbanlite.wip SETTINGS_FILE OUTPUT_FILE`. It loads SETTINGS_FILE the same way the board command loads its --settings file, and reads the board file named by the board_file setting.

Add a new setting, wip_limits: a JSON object that maps a column name to the largest number of cards allowed in that column. Columns that are not listed have no limit. When the settings file does not set it, no column has a limit.

Cards can also be marked as blocked now. In the board file a card may carry a "blocked" key whose value says what kind of block it is: "dependency" (waits for another card), "external" (waits for someone outside the team) or "decision" (waits for a decision). A card without the key is not blocked. Loading a board must keep this value, and saving a board must write it back for blocked cards only, so that the add and move commands do not lose it.

The check writes OUTPUT_FILE as JSON with two keys. "columns" is a list with one object per column, in board order (backlog, doing, review, done). Each object has the keys "name", "cards" (the number of cards in the column), "limit" (the limit of the column, or null) and "status": "ok" when the column has no limit or fewer cards than its limit, "full" when it has exactly its limit, and "over" when it has more. "blocked" is an object with the keys "dependency", "external" and "decision", in that order; each one maps to the list of ids of the blocked cards of that kind, in board file order.

A limit for a column that does not exist, a limit that is not a whole number of at least 1, and a card whose "blocked" value is not one of the three kinds must each fail with an error that a caller can catch. In that case the command tells the user what is wrong, exits with status 2 and does not write OUTPUT_FILE. Otherwise the command exits with status 1 when at least one column is over its limit, and with status 0 when none is.

Add tests for the new feature.
